title: Summer is Over?
summary: The proverbial, if not the actual, end of summer has arrived. Volumes and activity have not yet come roaring back, but markets’ first moves seem to generally echo the themes that had been prevailing for the past few weeks. Oil futures are higher, though not enough to fully spook equity and bond traders. The latter have seen prices meander around unchanged yield levels, while the former are modestly propping up tech and energy shares at the expense of most other sectors. Perhaps most are looking ahead to this week’s PPI and CPI reports, which became much more important after Fed Governor Waller’s speech last week.
